Shawwal reveals it. It’s easy to worship in a season where everything calls you back to Allah. But what comes after is the real question: will you remain? The Prophet ﷺ didn’t just leave us with a reward, but a way to stay rooted. The six days of fasting in Shawwal isn’t about adding more. It’s about holding on. Hold on to what you built.
